places.name: Eno River State Park — Cox Mountain Trail

access.name: Fews Ford access, 6101 Cole Mill Rd.
access.coords_source: NC State Parks lists the Fews Ford Access at 6101 Cole Mill Rd.; OpenStreetMap parking lot at the Cox Mountain Trail start matches.

places.name: William B. Umstead State Park — Company Mill Trail

access.name: Reedy Creek entrance, 2100 N. Harrison Ave.
access.coords_source: NC State Parks lists the Reedy Creek Entrance at 2100 N. Harrison Ave., Cary; OpenStreetMap parking lot at the end of N. Harrison Ave. matches.

access.name: Carolina North Forest (trailhead lot to be confirmed)
access.coords_source: Pin marks the forest itself (OpenStreetMap protected-area centre), not a lot. The trailhead lot off Municipal Dr. is described by guides but not mapped; confirm on the ground.

places.name: Hanging Rock State Park — Moore's Wall Loop

access.name: Visitor center lot, 1790 Hanging Rock Park Rd.
access.coords_source: NC State Parks lists the Main Visitor Center at 1790 Hanging Rock Park Rd., Danbury; OpenStreetMap "Visitor Center Parking Lot" matches.

access.name: Main lot, 625 Virginia Cates Rd.
access.coords_source: NC State Parks lists 625 Virginia Cates Rd., Hillsborough; OpenStreetMap parking lot and visitor information board at the end of the road match.

places.name: Hillsborough Riverwalk

access.name: Gold Park lot, 415 Dimmocks Mill Rd.
access.coords_source: Gold Park address 415 Dimmocks Mill Rd. geocodes to the OpenStreetMap Gold Park parking lot beside the Riverwalk. (Previous pin was about 1.4 km off.)

places.dog_policy: Leashed on the greenway; off leash only inside Gold Park’s fenced dog park. Maximum 6-foot leash entering and leaving it (Town rules).

access.name: Whitfield Rd. access by the New Hope fire station
access.coords_source: Trail guide (Carolina Nature) gives the Whitfield Rd. access at the New Hope fire station and community center, and OpenStreetMap shows the station there. Duke Forest publishes gate locations only on PDF maps (Gates 25 and 26), so this is corroborated, not official.

places.name: Raven Rock State Park — Raven Rock Loop

access.name: Main lot by the visitor center, 3009 Raven Rock Rd.
access.coords_source: NC State Parks lists the Main Access and Visitor Center at 3009 Raven Rock Rd., Lillington; OpenStreetMap parking beside the visitor center matches.

access.name: Brumley South lot, 3055 New Hope Church Rd.
access.coords_source: Triangle Land Conservancy lists Brumley South parking at 3055 New Hope Church Rd., Chapel Hill; the address and an OpenStreetMap parking lot coincide. (Previous pin was about 7 km off.)

places.name: Hanging Rock State Park — Hanging Rock Trail

access.name: Visitor center parking, 1005 Visitor Center Drive, Westfield
access.coords_source: NC State Parks official Hanging Rock home page links the visitor-center parking point through https://goo.gl/maps/m7MBCXyP1gQVwj9n7; it resolves to the public trailhead at 36.3952, -80.2665. Official trail listing identifies this lot as the Hanging Rock Trail start.

places.dog_policy: Pets on an attended leash no longer than six feet; no buildings or swim beach (NC State Parks).

routes.surface: Paved start, gravel, dirt, rock, wood and stone stairs; keep back from cliff edges.
Paved trail; cross Hanging Rock Park Road carefully.
Paved then gravel path to the observation deck; steps below the deck are optional and excluded here.

places.name: Jordan Lake State Recreation Area — New Hope Overlook

access.name: New Hope Overlook access, 339 W.H. Jones Road, New Hill
access.coords_source: NC State Parks current home page explicitly gives New Hope Overlook public access GPS 35.6772, -79.0454 and its linked directions pin agrees. Use this current public access pin, not the legacy PDF footer, which repeats the Crosswinds campground coordinates.

places.dog_policy: Attended leash, six feet maximum; no pets inside buildings or designated swimming areas (NC State Parks)

places.name: Haw River State Park — Iron Ore Belt Access

access.name: Iron Ore Belt parking, 6068 N. Church St., Greensboro
access.coords_source: Current NC State Parks home page explicitly lists Iron Ore Belt Access GPS 36.2374, -79.7855 and address 6068 N. Church St. The official April 2025 access map identifies the public parking, gate and Connector Trail; use this access, not The Summit.

places.dog_policy: Pets permitted on attended leashes no longer than 6 feet; not inside buildings.

routes.surface: Woodland hiking trail; include the Connector Trail approach and return.

places.name: Morrow Mountain State Park — Laurel Trail

access.name: Park office and museum parking, 49104 Morrow Mountain Road, Albemarle
access.coords_source: NC State Parks gives public park-office GPS 35.3737,-80.0735 at 49104 Morrow Mountain Road; the official map identifies office/museum visitor parking and the Laurel loop opposite that area. Follow the signed internal access, not a roadside parking pin.

places.dog_policy: Attended leash no longer than six feet. Pets stay outside buildings, pool and vacation cabins.

routes.surface: Natural woodland path; red-hexagon blazes. Roots and wet leaves can be slippery.
